# Get started

[Workflow](./README.md) | [Next: Project information](./project_information.md)

Start a decision project or return to an existing one. You can create a project from scratch or import a saved Prisma export.

## Overview

Use the home page to find an existing project, create a new project, or import a saved project export. Sign in using the method configured for your deployment: an organizational account for enterprise access, or a non-personal training username where demo access is enabled. Use only non-confidential training data in a demo. An empty list can simply mean no projects are available to the current account.

![Home page](<./figures/home/page - Home.png>)

## Create a project

Select **Create Project** to open the form for naming a new project.

![Create Project button](<./figures/home/button - Create Project.png>)

### Name a new project

Enter a descriptive project name in the creation form, using a distinguishing qualifier when similar projects exist. Confirm creation once, then wait for the project information page rather than submitting again while the request is pending.

![Empty Create Project form](<./figures/home/popup - Create Project.png>)

### Review the project name

The completed name field shows an example project ready to be created; check the name before submitting.

![Create Project form with a name entered](<./figures/home/popup - Create Project filled.png>)

## Import a saved project

### Import a project

Select **Import Project** to open the file picker for a Prisma project export.

![Import Project button](<./figures/home/button - Import Project.png>)

### Choose a project export

Choose a Prisma project export in JSON format using the import form. Import creates a new project rather than replacing the original. After importing, open the copy and review its issues, probability and utility tables, diagram, and calculated results before relying on it.

![Import Project form](<./figures/home/popup - Import Project.png>)

### Review the selected import

Check that the intended project export is selected before confirming the import. The exported model is not a complete decision record: assessment submissions are not included in the current download format. Keep review notes and important results separately and verify the imported copy.

![Import Project form with a file selected](<./figures/home/popup - Import Project file selected.png>)

## Find and open an existing project

### Search projects

Type part of a project name in **Search projects** to filter the project list.

![Project search field](<./figures/home/field - Search projects.png>)

### Review search results

The project list narrows as you type; clear the search field to show all accessible projects again.

![Home page with filtered project results](<./figures/home/page - Home search.png>)

### Open a project

Select a project card to open its project information page.

![Project card](<./figures/home/card - Project.png>)

## Keep frequently used projects at hand

### Favorite a project

Select the star on a project card to add or remove that project from your favorites.

![Favorite project button](<./figures/home/button - Favorite.png>)

### Find favorite projects

Projects marked with a star appear in **Favorite Projects** for quick access.

![Home page with a favorite project](<./figures/home/page - Home with favorite project.png>)
